# Colony fleets and population (slices 2-3 design §§ 3, 8, 10), per world:
#   sr_disp_site_target_<key>         2 our target, 1 we may target it now, 0 neither
#   sr_disp_site_inbound_<key>        fleets on their way there
#   sr_disp_site_inbound_months_<key> months until the first lands
#   sr_disp_site_inbound_ours_<key>   1 when the first is ours
#   sr_disp_site_pop_<key>            its people, whole
#   sr_disp_site_prio_<key>           our priority for it: 0 Closed, 1 Low, 2 Normal, 3 High
sr_disp_site_target_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 1 } value = 2 }
	else_if = { limit = { sr_solar_colonization_running = yes sr_cf_targetable_valles_marineris = yes } value = 1 }
}
sr_disp_site_inbound_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_valles_marineris } value = global_var:sr_site_inbound_valles_marineris }
}
sr_disp_site_inbound_months_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_first_valles_marineris } value = global_var:sr_site_inbound_first_valles_marineris subtract = te_history_month_index }
	min = 0
}

	add = sr_disp_mq_19
	add = sr_disp_mq_20
}

# Modules (slice 4 design § 11), per world:
#   sr_disp_mod_pending_<type>_<key>  our queue of the type and every shipment of it on its way
#   sr_disp_site_staffing_<key>       the colony's staffing, in percent
sr_disp_mod_pending_a_valles_marineris = {

# Colony Autonomy (slice 5 design § 9), per world:
#   sr_disp_site_aut_<key>        its autonomy, whole
#   sr_disp_site_aut_drift_<key>  its drift a month, ours only (0 otherwise)
#   sr_disp_site_aut_status_<key> 0 nothing, 1 chartered, 2 garrisoned, 3 both
#   sr_disp_free_<key>            1 while it is a free colony
#   sr_disp_free_ties_<key>       our ties with it, whole
#   sr_disp_free_supplied_<key>   1 while we supply it
sr_disp_site_aut_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_autonomy_value_valles_marineris
	floor = yes
}
sr_disp_site_aut_drift_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= this } value = sr_site_aut_drift_valles_marineris }
}
sr_disp_site_aut_status_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_charter_valles_marineris } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_valles_marineris } add = 2 }
}
sr_disp_free_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_valles_marineris } value = 1 }
}
sr_disp_free_ties_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_free_ties_value_valles_marineris
	floor = yes
}
sr_disp_free_supplied_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_valles_marineris } value = 1 }
}

# A colony's autonomy drift by term (audit SPC-15: its drift hover lists its own
# terms): its people, its distance by our drive, a year without contact. The
# country's terms (a war, a colony we destroyed) are sr_disp_aut_war and
# sr_disp_aut_destroyed; the flat ones are constants.
sr_disp_aut_people_valles_marineris = { value = sr_site_pop_value_valles_marineris divide = 10000 multiply = sr_aut_per_10k_people }
sr_disp_aut_distance_valles_marineris = { value = sr_transit_months_mars multiply = sr_aut_per_transit_month max = sr_aut_distance_cap }
sr_disp_aut_nocontact_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { sr_site_months_since_contact_valles_marineris > sr_aut_no_contact_months } value = 1 }
}
sr_disp_aut_people_olympus_mons = { value = sr_site_pop_value_olympus_mons divide = 10000 multiply = sr_aut_per_10k_people }
sr_disp_aut_distance_olympus_mons = { value = sr_transit_months_mars multiply = sr_aut_per_transit_month max = sr_aut_distance_cap }
sr_disp_aut_nocontact_olympus_mons = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { sr_site_months_since_contact_olympus_mons > sr_aut_no_contact_months } value = 1 }
}
sr_disp_aut_people_hellas_planitia = { value = sr_site_pop_value_hellas_planitia divide = 10000 multiply = sr_aut_per_10k_people }
sr_disp_aut_distance_hellas_planitia = { value = sr_transit_months_mars multiply = sr_aut_per_transit_month max = sr_aut_distance_cap }
sr_disp_aut_nocontact_hellas_planitia = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { sr_site_months_since_contact_hellas_planitia > sr_aut_no_contact_months } value = 1 }
}

# The free colonies, for the section's empty note.
sr_disp_free_count = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_valles_marineris } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_olympus_mons } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_hellas_planitia } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_utopia_planitia } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_arcadia_planitia } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_ceres } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_vesta } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_psyche } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_pallas } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_hygiea } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_io } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_europa } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_ganymede } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_callisto } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_himalia } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_amalthea } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_venus } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_mercury } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_titan } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_enceladus } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_rhea } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_mimas } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_iapetus } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_titania } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_oberon } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_miranda } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_ariel } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_triton } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_proteus } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_pluto } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_eris } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_makemake } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_haumea } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_sedna } add = 1 }
}

# The Solar System list's filter (audit SPC-7): 1 while the world is one our
# next colony fleet can go to (or our target), ours, or one a fleet is bound for;
# and how many such worlds each location and the whole system has.
sr_disp_ss_shown_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { OR = { sr_disp_site_target_valles_marineris >= 1 sr_disp_site_valles_marineris = 1 sr_disp_site_inbound_valles_marineris >= 1 } } value = 1 }
}

# The overview's Colonies cell (audit SPC-6): our colonies at or past the
# autonomy that demands self-government (sr_aut_ask_level).
sr_disp_aut_restless_count = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= this sr_site_autonomy_value_valles_marineris >= sr_aut_ask_level } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_olympus_mons ?= this sr_site_autonomy_value_olympus_mons >= sr_aut_ask_level } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_hellas_planitia ?= this sr_site_autonomy_value_hellas_planitia >= sr_aut_ask_level } add = 1 }

	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_vesta ?= this sr_site_autonomy_value_vesta >= sr_aut_ask_level } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_psyche ?= this sr_site_autonomy_value_psyche >= sr_aut_ask_level } add = 1 }
